oneLiner: A dashboard that instantly re-orients PMs when they switch projects, surfacing the last decision made, open blockers, and who's waiting on what.
problem: PMs juggling multiple projects lose critical context every time they switch, forcing them to re-read Slack threads and docs just to remember where things stood. This context-switching tax leads to dropped commitments, repeated questions, and stalled decisions because no one can quickly answer 'what happened last, what's blocking us, and who's waiting on me?'
targetUser: Product managers responsible for 3 or more concurrent projects or teams
coreFlow: PM logs in and sees a prioritized list of all active projects with last-touched timestamps
PM selects a project to re-enter after time away
Dashboard surfaces the last decision made, with context and date
Dashboard shows current blockers and their owners
Dashboard lists who is waiting on the PM and who the PM is waiting on
PM adds a quick note, resolves a blocker, or nudges a stakeholder
PM switches to the next project with full context retained

screens.name: Project Switcher
screens.purpose: Show all projects at a glance, ranked by recency and urgency, so PMs know where to focus first

screens.name: Project Context View
screens.purpose: Give a single-screen recap of the last decision, active blockers, and waiting-on relationships for one project

screens.name: Decision Log
screens.purpose: Provide a chronological history of key decisions so PMs and stakeholders can trace how a project got here

screens.name: Blocker Detail
screens.purpose: Let PMs view, update, or resolve a specific blocker and reassign ownership

screens.name: Daily Digest
screens.purpose: Summarize what's waiting across all projects so PMs can plan their day before diving in

outOfScope: Full task and project management (replacing tools like Jira or Asana)
